content:
Ivy Park: Starting HorizonCare onboarding kickoff thread. Objective: align stakeholders, define measurable success criteria, and lock down 30/60/90 milestones. Quick intros: Samir (CS), Tom (solutions engineering), Elena (customer PM).

Samir Joshi: Thanks Ivy. Who is day-to-day at HorizonCare?

Elena Gomez: Hey all 0 Elena here. Primary contact will be Noah (data lead). Exec sponsor: VP Product, Laila Hassan. Security point: Mateo in infosec.

Tom Wright: Ill take technical lead for integration. Need their expected qps, auth method, and whether they want hosted or private.

Ivy Park: From intake: expected 8k requests/day, spikes to 25k during morning syncs. They prefer private (VPC) but open to Dedicated if timeline tight.

Samir Joshi: Proposed success criteria: 1) End-to-end ingest -> inference -> app response working in staging 2) p95 latency < 550ms for 95% of pilot traffic 3) No e2e PII escapes on test suite 4) Enablement NPS >= 4 after sessions. Any additions?

Elena Gomez: Add acceptance criteria for embeddings recall on sample set (target F1 >= 0.78). We'll send labelled eval data.

Tom Wright: Technical checklist snippet for quick smoke test:

```
# set key
export REDWOOD_KEY=redwood_live_xxx
# basic call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

Tom Wright: Also need their allowlist and whether they require HSM-backed keys.

EnablementBot: Enablement session placeholder created: "HC Admin & Dev Workshop" on calendar (TBD).

Ivy Park: Draft 30/60/90: 30d = staging integration + admin training; 60d = pilot with 1 product route + monitoring; 90d = rollout to two additional routes + cost optimization.

Samir Joshi: Risks: (a) infosec review delaying credentials, (b) labelled eval not ready, (c) spike handling tuning. Mitigations: (a) Samir to triage infosec Qs, (b) Elena to prioritize eval dataset, (c) Tom to prepare autoscale profile and fallback policy.

Elena Gomez: I'll confirm Noah's calendar for the first integration sync tomorrow. Also sending their data retention policy doc.

Tom Wright: I'll prepare a minimal sandbox that works with synthetic data so they can start dev work before legal sign-off.

Ivy Park: Owners: Samir -> infosec + SLA; Tom -> sandbox + infra deep-dive; Elena -> customer coordination + sample data; Ivy -> timeline and ROI projection.

Samir Joshi: Quick question: do we want to include a canary rollout plan for model updates during pilot? Suggest yes.

Ivy Park: Agreed. Add canary with 10% traffic, 24h checks, auto rollback on degradation.

EnablementBot: Poll created: "Preferred admin training slots" (options: Tue 10am PT, Wed 2pm PT, Thu 9am PT).

Elena Gomez: I'll reply to the poll and push Noah to confirm prompts and eval targets by EOD tomorrow.

Tom Wright: Scheduling infra deep-dive Friday 11am PT; invite out.

Ivy Park: Thanks everyone. I'll post an updated timeline and a short onboarding checklist here by tomorrow noon. Flag blockers in this thread. :rocket:
